why: The terminal holder's restart press refuses in these words (wave 13u round 23). Each needs a terminal holder running, stopping or failing to start, so no door here can meet them. tests/the-terminal-holder-restarts-from-settings.test.ts meets the request's shape, a changed list, a holder that is not running and a full restart through the door, with a holder and a scratch server of its own. tests/a-holder-restart-that-ends-without-a-new-holder.test.ts meets the three that end a restart after the signal: a holder that still runs, a new holder that is turned off, and a new holder that does not answer in time.

refusals.english: Test: the restart was not asked in the form the door reads.
Test: no terminal holder the office can use is running.
Test: the holder or its terminals changed since the list was shown.
Test: the holder was not asked to stop.
Test: the holder still runs after it was asked to stop.
Test: the old holder stopped and a new one did not start.
Test: the new holder did not answer in time.
